failure_summary.description: The agent treated an affirmative answer containing a neighborhood preference as a no-op and failed to filter compatible cached hotel results.

patch.reasoning: The skill already instructs the agent to filter when a user adds criteria, but does not explicitly connect affirmative answers that include a value to the criterion asked about. Clarifying this interpretation should prevent an unsupported “No planning needed” response when cached results do not meet the newly stated preference.

edits.target: - Resolve brief affirmations such as “yes” against the immediately preceding assistant question or proposal, and carry forward the proposed entity or category as stated.
edits.content: - Resolve affirmative follow-ups, including answers like “Yes, [value] would be perfect,” against the immediately preceding assistant question or proposal. Map any included value to the criterion being asked about and treat it as a new constraint. If compatible cached results do not explicitly satisfy that constraint, retrieve the closest matching result, apply the relevant filter, and save the updated result; do not return “No planning needed” merely because related results are cached.
